questions.question: A triangle and a parallelogram have the same base 28 cm and the same area. If the height of the parallelogram is 12 cm, then find the length of the altitude of the triangle.
questions.solution:
Given:

A triangle and a parallelogram have the same base 28 cm and the same area.

The height of the parallelogram is 12 cm.

Concept used:

1. Area of a parallelogram = Base × Height

2. Area of a triangle = 1/2 × Height × Base

Calculation:

Area of the parallelogram = 28 × 12 = 336 cm²

Let the length of the altitude of the triangle be H cm.

​According to the question,

1/2 × H × 28 = 336

⇒ H = 12 × 2

⇒ H = 24

**∴ The length of the altitude of the triangle is 24 cm.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10 is lent by a child to his friend to be returned in 11 monthly instalments of Rs. 1 each, the interest being simple. The rate of interest is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A sum of Rs. 10 is lent by a child to his friend to be returned in 11 monthly instalments of Rs. 1 each, the interest being simple. 

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the rate of interest be R% p.a.

Total interest paid = 11 - 10 = Rs. 1

Since the installments are being paid monthly, the first, second, ...., and second-last EMI will incur interest for the next 10, 9, ...., and 1 month respectively. Since the last EMI completes the repayment, it will not incur any interest.

According to the concept,

(1 × R/100 × 10/12) + (1 × R/100 × 9/12) + (1 × R/100 × 8/12) + .... + (1 × R/100 × 1/12) = 1

⇒ frac {R}{1200} (10 + 9 + ... + 1) = 1

⇒ frac {R}{1200} times frac {11 times 10}{2} = 1

⇒ R = 1200/55

⇒ R = 21{ 9 over 11}%

∴ The rate of interest is 21{ 9 over 11}%.

questions.question: If a - b = 8 and ab = 9, then the value of a + b is ________.
questions.solution:
Given:

a - b = 8 and ab = 9

Concept used:

(a - b)2 = (a + b)2 - 4ab

Calculation:

(a - b) = 8

⇒ (a - b)² = 8²

⇒ (a + b)² - 4ab = 64

⇒ (a + b)2 = 64 + 4 × 9

⇒ (a + b)2 = 100

⇒ (a + b) = ±10

**∴ The value of (a + b) is ±10.**

questions.question: Sita gets a discount of 20% on Rs. 3,000 juicer mixer machine. Since she pays cash, she gets additional 5% discount too. How much does she pay?
questions.solution:
Given:

Sita gets a discount of 20% on Rs. 3,000 juicer mixer machine.

Since she pays cash, she gets an additional 5% discount too.

Concept used:

1. Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)

2. Final discount percentage after two successive discounts of A% and B% = (A + B - {AB over 100})\%

Calculation:

Final discount% = 20 + 5 - (20 × 5)/100 = 24%

Now, she pays = 3000(1 - 24%) = Rs. 2280

∴ She pays Rs. 2280.

The HCF of two numbers is 17 and the other two factors of their LCM are 11 and 19. The smaller of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Numbers are obtained by multiplying their HCF with the co-prime factors of their LCM.

Given HCF = 17 and the other two factors of LCM are 11 and 19.

Smaller Number = HCF × Smaller factor

Smaller Number = 17 × 11 = 187

**∴ The correct answer is 187.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF of two numbers = 17

Other two factors of their LCM = 11 and 19

**Formula Used:**

If HCF of two numbers is H, then the numbers can be expressed as Hx and Hy, where x and y are co-prime factors.

LCM of these numbers = Hxy

 
 HCF = 17
 
• 
 × 11
 
 Smaller Number
 17 × 11 = 187
 
• 
 × 19
 
 Larger Number
 17 × 19 = 323
 Result: Smaller Number = 187

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the two numbers be 17x and 17y.

⇒ LCM = 17xy

⇒ It is given that the factors of the LCM (other than the HCF) are 11 and 19.

⇒ So, the values are x = 11 and y = 19.

⇒ First number = 17 × 11 = 187

⇒ Second number = 17 × 19 = 323

⇒ Therefore, the smaller number is 187.

**∴ The correct answer is 187.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between HCF and LCM

The product of two given numbers is always exactly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

Co-prime Factors

When we divide the LCM of two numbers by their HCF, the resulting quotient gives the product of two co-prime factors. These specific factors multiply individually with the HCF to yield the original two numbers.

If 2p + q = 19 and 8p³ + q³ = 361, then find the value of pq.
questions.solution:
Given:

2p + q = 19 and 8p3 + q3 = 361

Concept used:

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 - 3ab(a + b)

Calculation:

8p3 + q3 = 361

⇒ (2p + q)³ - 3 × 2p × q (2p + q) = 361

⇒ (2p + q)3 - 6pq(2p + q) = 361

⇒ 193 - 6pq × 19 = 361

⇒ 19² - 6pq = 19

⇒ 6pq = 19² - 19

⇒ 6pq = 342

⇒ pq = 57

∴ The value of pq is 57.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is correct?

I. If x = 12, y = -2 and z = -10, then x³ + y³ + z³ = 720

II. If x + y = 48 and 4xy = 128, then s the value of 4x² + 4y² is 8960
questions.solution:
Given:

I. If x = 12, y = -2 and z = -10, then x3 + y3 + z3 = 720

II. If x + y = 48 and 4xy = 128, then s the value of 4x2 + 4y2 is 8960

Concept used:

a² + b² + 2ab = (a + b)²

Calculation:

I. x3 + y3 + z3 

⇒ (12)³ + (-2)3 + (-10)3 

⇒ 1728 - 8 - 1000

⇒ 720

II. Here, 4xy = 128

⇒ 2xy = 64 ....(1)

x + y = 48

⇒ (x + y)² = 48²

⇒ x² + y² + 2xy = 2304

⇒ x2 + y2 = 2304 - 64 (From 1)

⇒ x2 + y2 = 2240

⇒ 4x2 + 4y2 = 4 × 2240

⇒ 4x2 + 4y2 = 8960

Hence, both I and II follow.

**∴ Both I and II are correct statements.**

questions.question: A four-digit pin, say abcd, of a lock has different non-zero digits. The digits satisfy b = 2a, c = 2b, d = 2c. The pin is divisible by ________.
questions.solution:
Given:

A four-digit pin, say abcd, of a lock, has different non-zero digits.

The digits satisfy b = 2a, c = 2b, d = 2c.

Calculation:

c = 2b

⇒ c = 2 × 2a = 4a ...(1)

d = 2c

⇒ d = 2 × 4a = 8a ....(2)

Now, the pin

⇒ abcd = 1000 × a + 100 × b + 10 × c + 1 × d

⇒ abcd = 1000 × a + 100 × 2a + 10 × 4a + 1 × 8a

⇒ abcd = 1000a + 200a + 40a + 8a

⇒ abcd = 1248a

⇒ abcd = (78 × 16)a

⇒ abcd = ((2 × 3 × 13) × 16)a

Hence, the pin is divisible by 2, 3, 13.

**∴ The pin is divisible by 2, 3, 13.**

questions.question: ΔABC and ΔDEF are similar triangles and their areas are 49 cm² and 144 cm² respectively. If EF = 16.80 cm, then find BC.
questions.solution:
Given:

ΔABC and ΔDEF are similar triangles and their areas are 49 cm2 and 144 cm2 respectively.

EF = 16.80 cm

Concept used:

If two triangles are similar, then the ratio of the area of both triangles is proportional to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Calculation:

Since ΔABC and ΔDEF are similar triangles,

frac {AB}{DE} = frac {BC}{EF} = frac {AC}{DF} = sqrt { frac {area (Delta ABC)}{area (Delta DEF)}}

⇒ frac {BC}{EF} = sqrt { frac {area (Delta ABC)}{area (Delta DEF)}}

⇒ frac {BC}{16.80} = sqrt { frac {49}{144} }

⇒ BC = 7/12 × 16.80

⇒ BC = 9.8

**∴ The length of BC is 9.8 cm.**
